title: Light Bulb Circuit MicroSim
description: Interactive circuit simulation demonstrating a switch-controlled light bulb with animated current flow visualization
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Electric Circuits
Light Bulbs
Switches
Current Flow
Energy Conversion
learningObjectives: Trace the closed loop of current from the battery through the switch and light bulb and back to the battery
Explain how opening the switch breaks the conducting path so that current stops everywhere in the loop at once
Predict whether the bulb will glow for a given switch position, then verify the prediction against the animated electron flow
Explain how the bulb converts electrical energy into light and heat, and why it needs continuous current to keep glowing
Distinguish the animation Speed and Spacing sliders as display settings from the switch, which is the only control that changes circuit behavior
